A control that derives terminal authority from matching command TEXT rather than from evidence that a check actually ran hands authority back to the very proposal source it exists to subordinate, so a load-bearing kernel cited by a capability binding has to be verified for satisfiability by non-verifying inputs and for its behaviour on malformed inputs, not only for correct rejection of failing ones. Negative teeth and positive sufficiency are independent properties: a gate can be perfectly sound at blocking bad evidence and still be trivially satisfiable, and only the second property is what a materiality claim about successful verification evidence actually asserts. A third, separable property is that the artefacts which authorize an execution must pin the runtime they certify by hash, otherwise the word exact in EXACT_CURRENT_RUNTIME_VERIFICATION is unverifiable from the record alone. And when a mutation probe reports survivors, the first hypothesis must be that the probe itself is mis-scoped rather than that the code is redundant, because a mutant written into one tree and evaluated from another compares two pristine files and returns a spurious SURVIVED.

A finding that names a missing pin must be checked against the whole citation chain before it is believed, because a binding artefact may delegate its hash expectations to the verification artefacts it cites; and a pin census must pair each sha-key with the name-key in the SAME dict, otherwise every sibling pin is attributed to the first name-key and a fully exact cone is reported as drifted. A defect's severity is set by its consumers, not by its own code: a weakness in a control that no recorded verdict depends on is prospective, and saying so is what keeps a real finding from being over-read as contamination. Finally, an authorized route is only as close to the goal as the shape of the bar it is authorized against, so a conjunction of fixed bars must be read as requiring every conjunct, each with its own cost and case-exposure budget, not as one executable step.

When a control plane advances, the first obligation is to recompute its frontier independently from canonical inputs rather than read its own summary, because a summary can be stale while the recomputation is exact, and only the recomputation shows which single precondition still gates the authorized step. A threshold cut must be classified as tightening or weakening by counting required wins against a fixed denominator, never by comparing percentages, and its slack must be quantified because a conservative zero-credit rule converts slack into a permanent fail-lock once it is exhausted. And a cross-check that disagrees with the record is more often a level confusion in the check than an error in the record, so before reporting a discrepancy one must confirm that both sides of the comparison are derived at the same level of the same structure.

A verifier that gates whether a candidate may proceed to a one-shot lease must be mutation-tested against its own suite, because a suite that only asserts the presence of error strings never constrains the verdict itself, and a verdict that can be hardcoded to true while every test still passes is not a control. Equally, a test file's green status means nothing until the runner that reports it is shown to have collected the tests, since a module of bare pytest-style functions reports 'Ran 0 tests' and OK under unittest and therefore launders a live red into an apparent pass. And a census of test collection must be validated against ground truth rather than against an AST heuristic, because a heuristic that recognizes only TestCase and synchronous methods silently misclassifies IsolatedAsyncioTestCase files with async tests.

Executing a search action means proving a negative over the whole corpus, not sampling it, so the discriminating field names of the acceptance test must be searched tree-wide and their absence reported as absence from recorded artifacts rather than as absence from the world. Before reporting that a mechanism has no inputs one must confirm which document the mechanism is wired to read, because feeding it a plausible but unwired ledger produces the same empty verdict for the wrong reason and launders an input error into a finding. And when two vocabularies are supposed to interoperate, the intersection of their term sets decides whether the pipe is merely empty or structurally disconnected, which are different defects with different repairs.

When a control plane revokes the only authorized route on mathematical grounds, the first obligation is to replay the arithmetic independently rather than accept the verdict, because a revocation is as consequential as an authorization and either can be wrong. The second obligation is to test the revoking gate in the direction that reopens the route, since a fail-closed compiler whose exclusion lists are filtered before they are validated can be made to fail open by malformed input, and the number of malformed rows needed to flip a verdict is a property worth computing exactly. The third is to distinguish a hardware limit from a creditability limit, because only the second can be repaired by argument while the first can only be repaired by money, and a search action that asks for admissible changes must be answered with the resource requirement that makes them inadmissible.

When every route to a goal is reported blocked, the question that decides whether the goal is unreachable or merely unattempted is whether each blocker's own recorded discharge condition is satisfiable under the standing constraints, so the classification must be taken from the discharge conditions rather than from the blocker labels, and a predicate with no blocker certificate at all must be treated as a separate class because its absence means the residual compiler could not name a wall for it. A proof template that succeeded once for a predicate kind is not thereby available for every predicate of that kind, so the protocol governing each candidate predicate must be read for its own admission preconditions before the template is assumed to transfer. And when the only remaining lever is an action whose execution is forbidden by the delivery's own governance shape rather than by cost or evidence, that must be stated as a structural impossibility with the specific rule that causes it, not as a lack of ideas.
